picks.title: Paperclip: the app people use to manage agents at work
picks.summary: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents: org charts, budgets, governance, heartbeats and a ticket system in one dashboard.
picks.implementation_idea: Run the four-seat trading system as a Paperclip org: one agent per seat with per-agent token budgets and approval gates before any live Upstox order.

picks.title: DeepSeek Harness: everything-is-a-plugin agent harness
picks.summary: DeepSeek's official agent harness where every capability ships as a plugin, making agent stacks composable and swappable.
picks.implementation_idea: Write a radar-tracker plugin for the harness: each plugin polls one launch source and feeds candidates to a JEV decision layer for scoring and dedupe.

picks.title: OmniRoute
picks.summary: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers and 500+ models with quota-aware auto-fallback.
picks.implementation_idea: Front the OpenRouter JEV calls with OmniRoute for provider fallback and token-compression savings.
picks.reason: Strongest build idea in the feed

picks.title: ai-memory: long-term memory for agent coding CLIs
picks.summary: Rust solution for long-term memory for agent coding CLIs, facilitating handoff between different agents and sessions.
picks.implementation_idea: Give the radar updater long-term memory via ai-memory: remember which sources produced real launches so each run starts with a learned source priority list.
